summary: This bill reauthorizes funding for state-based maternal mortality review committees, expands the types of data they can collect, and directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to disseminate best practices for preventing maternal mortality and morbidity to hospitals and other relevant groups.

scores.thoughts: This bill reauthorizes and expands funding for maternal mortality review committees and directs the dissemination of best practices to prevent maternal deaths. This directly relates to improving healthcare outcomes, specifically in maternal health, which is a core aspect of public health services.

The bill increases authorized annual appropriations for the maternal mortality prevention program from $58 million to $100 million for FY2025–2029, directly raising federal spending without any offsetting revenue or cuts.
